Maria P.: Heads-up: small uptick in hallucination counts on the FP8 rollout for mix-qa. Not huge but reproducible on the canary traffic. Thinking we should run a focused bisect playbook + a tiny mini-bench to isolate layer/op causes. Thoughts?
Aran T.: Can we reproduce deterministically offline? If so propose: fixed RNG seed, same KV-cache warmup, single-threaded, and a small anchor prompt set.
Dave R.: I built a quick runner to do per-layer drop-in tests. Example: ```./quant-mini-bench --model ./m.pt --prompts anchors.json --quant-profile fp8-probe --layer-swap 12 --seed 42 --warmup 8 --batch 1``` Results output logs with logits diff per token.
Sophia L.: Important: include KV cache warmup + streaming off — runtime differences can hide the signal. Also tag runs with .telemetry.label=fp8-bisect so the infra traces pick it up.
jenkins-bot: Job started: quant-mini-bench #789 (fp8-probe) — logs streaming to https://ci.internal/runs/789 :eyes:
Maria P.: Goal for the mini-bench: ~500 short samples (<=128 tokens), ~200ms/sample wall on dedicated infra, compute per-token logit drift, top-k flips, and ngram overlap. If we can get a clear layer candidate we escalate to 5k samples. Hypothesis: attention softmax or scale-cast path when using FP8 accumulators.
Aran T.: Agree. Also capture pre-softmax logits and softmax outputs, not just final tokens. We often miss subtle drift if we only look at outputs. Need per-token KL and %top1 flips.
Dave R.: Suggest binary-search style bisect: 1) layer halves (first/second half), 2) if problematic half found, split again, 3) repeat until layer or op isolated. Keep a reproducible seed for each run and store run-metadata like quant-config hash.
Maria P.: Good. Also include a control baseline run with INT8 and FP16. Add a run where we enable `quant-fp8-softmax-stable=true` (experimental) to test casting workaround.
Sophia L.: I'll provision a 4x A10g mini-pool for the runs. I can set up a harness that automates the bisect sequence and uploads artifacts (logits, diffs, summary table) to the experiment bucket. ETA: today afternoon. :thumbsup:
Dave R.: Minimal config we need in the runner: ["quant_profile","layer_swap","seed","warmup_steps","capture_logits","telemetry_tag"]. Example flags: `--quant_profile=fp8-e2e --fallback=int8-hotpath --hysteresis=0.025`
Maria P.: Nice. For acceptance criteria: if KL divergence per-token > 0.01 on >5% of tokens or top1 flip rate > 3% across anchors we mark as regression. These thresholds are conservative; we can tune after first pass.
Aran T.: Also watch out for prompt-length sensitivity. Run anchors at 8, 32, 128 tokens. Some drift only surfaces on long context.
jenkins-bot: Baseline runs completed: fp16 -> job 786, int8 -> job 787. fp8 probe job 789 in progress. Artifacts: s3://redwood-experiments/quant/bisect/4769124333/
Sophia L.: I'll add the run orchestration YAML to infra: ```job:
  name: quant-bisect-mini
  pool: mini-4x-a10g
  steps:
    - run: quant-mini-bench --anchors anchors.json --profile $profile --out $out
    - upload: $out -> s3://redwood-experiments/quant/$run_id
```
Maria P.: After we have candidate layers, we should do a quick ablation: (a) swap only attention proj weights, (b) swap only q/k/v, (c) swap MLP fc1/fc2. That narrows ops.
Dave R.: If the bisect pins it to attention softmax cast path we can try two runtime fixes: enforce FP16 accumulate for softmax or add a pre-softmax scaling clamp. We'll measure cost impact too.
Aran T.: Add a telemetry metric name: `quant.layer_drift_pct` and tag with layer idx + profile. Ops team can ingest that for long-term monitoring.
Maria P.: Plan of record: run the mini-bisect today, share summary in this thread, then schedule a 20-min sync tomorrow if we have a layer candidate. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
